leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a generic type that transforms tuple types into union types
Apply indexed access types to extract elements from tuple types
Construct a mapped type to iterate over tuple indices
Manipulate tuple type parameters using conditional type inference
Initialize type transformations that preserve tuple element order in unions
Integrate the TupleToUnion type with existing TypeScript type definitions
Configure type constraints to ensure proper tuple type handling
